title: Chapter 28 The Enemy Ran Away, Not Enough Fighting
content:
Chapter 28 The Enemy Ran Away, Not Enough Fighting

For a moment, the entire void began to tremble.

In just a moment, the people of Xieyun Sect and Tianjian Sect knew that the person in front of them was not simple.

"You are not from the Xuangu Galaxy."

A strong man from outside the system said in a deep voice.

Hearing this, the people of the two sects immediately understood.

They could not see through the strength of the armored man in front of them. It turned out that he was also from outside the Xuangu Galaxy like them.

However, Yunqi just looked at everyone coldly and said indifferently: "Those who invade our deserted city will be punished even if they are far away!"

The next moment, more than 300,000 soldiers behind him roared and rushed directly towards the people of the two sects.

The momentum was like a rainbow.

For a moment, the entire void began to collapse continuously.

Quantitative change leads to qualitative change.

Yunqi had no intention of taking action, so he silently commanded behind him.

Because he had reached the unknown realm.

As long as no strong man from the unknown realm took action, he would not take action.

If he took action, it would be a dimensionality reduction attack.

These trained troops still need to be honed.

"Follow the Lu family army!"

"Brothers, let's go together!"

"Long live the Wasteland City!"

Suddenly, several breaths from the Wasteland City rose into the sky and came to the void one after another, fighting against the enemies outside the system together with the Lu family army.

"Young master, what should we do?"

The old man asked worriedly on the black warship.

Hearing this, the young master of the Xieyun Sect, Mo Xietian, said coldly: "What should we do? What else can we do, go ahead."

"All of you, go ahead and kill these natives!"

The next moment, everyone from the Xieyun Sect rushed directly towards the Wasteland City army.

Not far away, the Tianjian Sect was no exception.

"All people from the Tianjian Sect, listen to my order, and show no mercy under the sword!"

Finally, the two forces collided with each other.

Boom!

With a deafening roar.

A huge black hole suddenly appeared in the void.

The terrifying suction force madly attracted everything around it, which was particularly creepy.

Below, in the mansion of the Lord of the Deserted City.

Lu Daosheng sat in the courtyard, watching the battle above with satisfaction.

These people were not cultivated in vain.

So many resources were spent, not to keep idle people.

If even such things require him to do it personally, then what is the point of creating a force.

It is better to take his daughter to travel around the world.

A moment later, An Xing suddenly appeared in the courtyard carrying a black sack.

Then, An Xing slowly walked to Lu Daosheng and knelt on one knee.

"Lord, I have caught the leader of the other party."

"Oh?"

So fast, the efficiency is very high.

Lu Daosheng immediately looked at An Xing with an admiring look, and then smiled and said: "Get up."

"Thank you, Lord."

An Xing said excitedly.

He knew that he would be very successful in the future.

Although he has been very successful now, he doesn't mind flying higher.

Then, An Xing stood up and threw the sack on the ground.

"City Lord, these two groups are the Xieyun Sect of the Dark Galaxy and the Tianjian Sect of the Giant Sword Galaxy."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded.

He had actually deduced these things a long time ago, and asked An Xing to go just to see the strength of this leader.

Obviously, An Xing did not disappoint him.

"Open it."

Then, the sack was opened, and Mo Xietian's figure appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

At this time, Mo Xieyun's face still showed a look of horror, as if he had seen something terrible.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng snapped his fingers.

Mo Xietian immediately returned to his original state.

"Ah!!"

"Who, who dares to sneak attack me?"

Mo Xietian shouted a few words in panic, but then he found that the scene had changed.

Looking up at the middle-aged man in front of him who had no breath, Mo Xietian's heart skipped a beat.

His many years of experience told him that the person in front of him was definitely not ordinary.

"You, you,"

At this time, Mo Xietian noticed the sky again.

Seeing the battle in the void, Mo Xieyun immediately understood.

He was caught in the other party's lair.

Isn't the other party a force of a low-level galaxy? Why is it so strong? It's too abnormal.

"Mo Xietian."

At this time, Lu Daosheng said slowly.

When he heard the other party say his name, Mo Xietian couldn't help shaking.

"You, what do you want to do?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled.

"I should ask, what do you want to do?"

Suddenly, Mo Xietian reacted.

"Senior, as long as you are willing to let me go, I will leave now and promise never to invade the Xuan Gu galaxy again."

Mo Xietian said immediately.

However, Lu Daosheng just smiled and said nothing.

What did he do earlier?

"Take him away."

"Yes, City Lord."

Then, An Xing looked at Mo Xietian with an evil smile.

This smile immediately made Mo Xietian's scalp numb, and an extremely ominous premonition came to his mind.

"What do you want to do? I tell you, if something happens to me, Xieyun Sect will be irreconcilable with you."

However, An Xing did not reply to him, but took him directly and disappeared in the yard.

"Dad, will you kill him?"

At this time, Lu Xue asked on the side.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng touched Lu Xue's head and smiled: "What do you think will happen if you fall into their hands?"

Suddenly, Lu Xue stopped talking.

The ending is predictable, and it will definitely not be good.

Lu Daosheng smiled, and then said seriously: "Xiaoxue, you must have the ability to distinguish right from wrong. Dad can always protect you and support you, but Dad doesn't want you to become a stupid person, do you know?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue lowered her head.

"Dad, I know."

Looking at Lu Xue's appearance, Lu Daosheng didn't say anything else.

When you experience more things, you will understand everything.

And above the void.

At this time, the heat in the Xieyun Sect and the Tianjian Sect has become more and more difficult, and their eyes are full of disbelief.

Why does a fourth-level galaxy have such a powerful strength.

Even with those treasures, they can't do this in such a short time.

"Young Master, it's not good, we are careless, young, huh?!"

"Where is the young master?!!!"

The old man of the Xieyun Sect exclaimed immediately.

Then, everyone in the Xieyun Sect was shocked. Without paying attention, a large number of strong men were killed by the Lu family army and the strong men in the deserted city.

"Ah, damn it, retreat, retreat quickly!"

"Retreat!"

An ancient realm strong man from the Xieyun Sect said with an ugly face.

On the side, another ancient realm strong man from the Xieyun Sect also had an extremely ugly face.

They did not join the battle because they were being targeted.

Behind the army, the man in dark gold armor just stared at the two of them.

The terrifying sense of oppression was very strong.

They had a possibility in their hearts that they dared not imagine at all.

Unknown realm?

They did not dare to think too much, and then drove the warship to leave.

Seeing the Xieyun Sect retreat, everyone in the Tianjian Sect was immediately in a dilemma.

At present, with their strength, they could not deal with the forces of the Xuan Gu Galaxy.

Without thinking too much, the Tianjian Sect also began to withdraw from the battlefield.

"General, should we chase them?"

A general saw the enemy retreating and immediately stepped forward to ask Yunqi.

Looking at the people of the two sects, Yunqi wanted to completely destroy them, but at this time, a voice came into his ears.

"Come back first."

Hearing this familiar voice, Yunqi immediately said: "Return."

Then, above the void, everyone returned to the deserted city without hesitation.

A moment later, the void returned to calm again, leaving only the broken void.

At the same time, the whole deserted city began to cheer.

In the city lord's mansion.

"City lord."

Yunqi came to Lu Daosheng with an excited look.

"Thank you for your hard work."

Lu Daosheng smiled.

Hearing this, Yunqi was a little embarrassed, as if he had not done much just now.

At this time, Lu Daosheng said: "I said, you have worked hard to train this army."

Yunqi reacted and smiled: "It's all thanks to the resources given by the city lord."

No matter how strong he is in training soldiers, without resources, nothing can work.

At this time, Yunqi remembered something and asked, "City Lord, why did you let those guys go?"

With his strength, he can definitely keep everyone.

After hearing this, Lu Daosheng said, "They will come back, and when they come again, they will be stronger and more numerous than before."

Hearing this, Yunqi immediately understood and said, "City Lord, don't worry, as long as I am here, I will definitely protect the city of Huang."

"I should say this, right?"

At this time, a voice suddenly sounded.

The next moment, Huang Shou appeared in the field.

Seeing Huang Shou, Yunqi bowed respectfully and said, "Senior Huang."

Huang Shou nodded and looked at Lu Daosheng.

"Lord City Lord."

"What's wrong?"

"Lord City Lord, next time the enemy comes, can I also go up?"

Looking at the battle in the void, he really couldn't stand the loneliness.

After hearing this, Lu Daosheng felt helpless.

Why are there only fighting maniacs under his command?

At this time, Lu Xue, who was standing by, was delighted, and then smiled and said, "Dad, my master is going to break through."

"Oh? Really?"

Lu Xue nodded.

"Yes, Master said that he couldn't break through because he lacked a battle."

And now, Gu Chen successfully broke through the bottleneck of the Dao Realm.

Suddenly, a huge movement was heard in a training room in the City Lord's Mansion.

Seeing the movement of Gu Chen's breakthrough, the people present, except Lu Xue, all nodded.

Such a strange phenomenon, it seems that Gu Chen's talent is really high.

The City Lord is indeed discerning.
